nodes.author: StayMadLuLz
nodes.text:
That virus has been around for more than 20 years, and only recently discovered in the year 2000. The discovery of that virus explains why people that tested negative for the flu and COVID, were left confused. It's Because they had this virus...

It's been around for a long time and since its discovery in 2000, there is still no vaccine or cure for it. I've had it twice since COVID, and probably had it before COVID and just didn't know it.
